rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for stating an obligation or giving a direct instruction to do V.

example.english: You have to hand in your homework right away.
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zik1 hak1 gaau1 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use 到 for contact or an endpoint, a resulting state or effect, a degree reached, and the upper end of a range.

example.english: I stopped when I got to the doorway.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 dou3 mun4 hau2 zau6 ting4 dai1

rows.note: Use 對 + N when an adjective describes how something applies or is directed toward a person or thing, as in 對佢好.

example.english: This company is fair to its employees.
example.traditional: 呢間公司對員工好公平。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 deoi3 jyun4 gung1 hou2 gung1 ping4

rows.note: Use 畀 + N for the recipient of a transfer, as in 畀本書佢.

example.english: I will give the document to you tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 bei2 fan6 man4 gin6 nei5
